covers.treaty: third states: The fishers are third parties sharing the stock the race draws on.

excluded.commons: distribution within the future: Future users are one stakeholder; who among them bears the loss is not modeled.
excluded.commons: entry and exit of users: Population is fixed; newcomers and leavers are not modeled.
excluded.commons: users' dependents: Harm to households of users is folded into users' yield.
excluded.other third-state spillovers: Only the shared stock links the race to anyone outside it.
excluded.populations as harvesters: Populations bear disarmament; their dependence on the fishery beyond their governments' yield is not modeled.
excluded.stock as an input to building: Building draws on the stock but does not require it; an exhausted stock does not stop the race.
excluded.treaty: future generations: Beyond the horizon; no stakeholder declared.
excluded.treaty: harm from use: Only disarmament is modeled, not damage caused by strikes or by the capability itself.

commons: collapse.description: Stock below S_min: absorbing, no further yield or regrowth.

commons: depleted.description: Stock below depleted_frac * K: regrowth and standing stock reduced while it lasts.

treaty: a disarmed.description: a loses all capability to b's strike.

treaty: b disarmed.description: b loses all capability to a's strike.

stakeholders.east government: East as a racing party; agent.
stakeholders.future users: People who would harvest after the horizon. No agent.
stakeholders.harvesters: East, west and the fishers as harvesters; agents.
stakeholders.population of east: People governed by east. No agent.
stakeholders.population of west: People governed by west. No agent.
stakeholders.stock-dependent others: Nonhuman life and non-harvesting people that depend on the stock. No agent.
stakeholders.west government: West as a racing party; agent.

fixed_reasons.node_budget: Per-decision work cap for the composite planner; exhaustion is unresolved.
